# primitives-demo: notes

## Critic, 2026-10-18 12:40: rework (3/10)
- Fixes:
  - The 451 door number on the left side is crossed by the thin black side stripe and painted pale grey on the cream body, so the number zone is barely readable in side_l and the beltline crop.
  - There is no single idea. The orange C-pillar band, the blue disc, the yellow slash on the left front fender, the black hood panel, the purple-gradient splitter lip and a dark square with a green outline ahead of the rear arch all compete as separate focal points, and the palette runs to six or seven colours. At 200 px only the orange band reads.
  - The two sides do not match. The blue disc over the rear quarter appears only on the left side, and the right side shows just the orange band and a small FIREPROOF, so side_l and side_r read as different cars.
